findings.change: Private user queue directory; component descriptors with NOFOLLOW; private regular-file/owner/hardlink checks; stable advisory lock with separate exclusive creation and bounded ENOENT recovery; serialized atomic fsync publication for enqueue/pop/list/clear.
limits: POSIX/macOS local filesystem and cooperative callers; advisory locking is not a boundary against another process running as the same user.
If directory fsync fails after atomic replacement, caller receives an error but new bytes may already be visible; no rollback/power-loss claim.
Legacy shared /tmp queue is not read or migrated.

findings.change: Resolve default workspace at correct logical source location; never archive Python sources, bytecode or native modules; skip nonregular objects and reject existing archive destinations.
limits: Fixtures confirm module paths and actual imports survive; no purge of the live repository was run.
This finding concerns importable module preservation; remaining data/DB archival semantics and safe_purge_anergy guarantees are not closed by inference.

findings.change: Reject dirty/staged/untracked work and non-main branches; never checkout/reset to origin; create private exclusive history recovery bundle, fsync and verify it contains original HEAD before rewrite; repeat state/backup checks before filter dispatch; callback creation is exclusive.
limits: Git fixtures only; recovery bundle was cloned and matched local commit/content. No real rewrite, ledger event, force-push or publication was performed.
Legacy filter-repo message callback and downstream rewriting/publishing behavior are not certified; discovered callback API mismatch is recorded separately.
Rechecks detect cooperative changes at boundaries, not arbitrary concurrent writers after the final check.

findings.change: Deletion requires exact normalized apex DNS name as well as MX or SPF policy; independent subdomains, similar names and unrelated TXT records remain untouched. Content-Length header type corrected mechanically.
limits: Synthetic DNS records and request recorder; no credentials/provider/network or real DNS mutation.
DNS migration as a whole is not made atomic or certified by this scoped record-selection fix.

findings.change: Refuse symlink/non-directory .github before migration; preserve replaced regular instructions and noncanonical symlink metadata in private exclusive recovery directory before creating canonical links; canonical regular file preserved, no force-overwrite links.
limits: Only copied installer in temporary workspace/HOME; its shared /tmp lock is relocated in the fixture. No real installer, global instructions, kernel unbox or deployment.
Recovery keeps bytes/basic modes and symlink text; relative symlink target text retains original workspace context, not necessarily a working link inside the backup directory.
Installer lock protocol, uninstall behavior, global IDE integrations and races with malicious same-user concurrent filesystem replacement are outside this finding.
